evals.name: contact-earlier-in-the-week
evals.prompt: Had coffee with Barbara on Monday.
evals.expected_output: Today is Thursday 5 November 2026 and 'Barbara (every 3 weeks)' is due today. The contact date is Monday 2 November, so the next due date is 23 November. Robin updates the task in place and confirms in one line.
expectations: Uses Monday 2 November 2026 as the contact date
Sets the next due date to 2026-11-23
Updates the existing task instead of creating a duplicate

evals.name: month-end-interval

expectations: Uses 31 March 2026 as the contact date
Sets the next due date to 2026-04-30
